title: Director of Engineering at nVent Electric plc Is Positive on Asia Vital Components’ Growth and Competitive Position in Data Center Cooling
expert: Director of engineering (data-center thermal R&D) at nVent Electric, an AVC competitor (current)
verdict: A competitor's engineering director (no view of AVC's books) estimates AVC's 55% blended cold-plate share settles at 40%–50% on Vera Rubin and expects 5%–10% price declines once Nvidia standardizes cold plates.

Nvidia content and share: 🔴 AVC 55% blended share to 40%–50% on Vera Rubin (estimate) as Auras qualifies, vs Celestica's 60/40–50/50 production splits (2026-11-06 call): consistent. → Tenet 1 (Nvidia content and share) ↓
Gross margin: 🔴 Cold-plate prices to fall 5%–10% on Nvidia standardization (estimate; up to 50% heard), vs Dell commodity manager's 40–50% reference-price fall (2026-11-06 call): smaller. → Tenet 3 (GM 34%+) ↓
ASIC liquid-cooling start: 🟢 Custom-ASIC vs GPU liquid revenue about 50/50 by 2027 (estimate), consistent with mgmt's ASIC >50% of liquid revenue in 2027 (SB #54848). → Tenet 2 (ASIC ramp) ↑

changes: AVC share 55% blended to 40%–50% on Vera Rubin (estimate) vs Celestica's planned 60/40–50/50 production splits (2026-11-06 call): consistent.
Cold-plate price decline 5%–10% (estimate) vs Dell commodity manager's reference prices down 40–50% (2026-11-06 call): smaller cut expected.
Rubin yields 60%–70% rising to about 80% (hearsay) vs ex-SMCI GM's ~80% (2026-11-06 call): same read; up from ~60% in May (SB #64479).
Auras ~4% to over 10% share (hearsay) vs nVent site-ops director's identical read (2026-11-06 call): repeated hearsay, not new evidence.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (Nvidia content and share): ↓ — share estimated at 40%–50% on Vera Rubin from 55% blended.
Tenet 2 (ASIC ramp): ↑ — ASIC vs GPU liquid revenue about 50/50 by 2027 (estimate).
Tenet 3 (Margin and EPS): → — yield and optimization worth about 4–5 points of margin (estimate) offset by 5%–10% standardization price cuts.
